reconciliation_notes: Catalogs have different reference universes and dates; compare exact CoinGecko id rather than rank or ticker alone.
Presence in catalog indicates an indexed source but does not certify complete trading history, release bytes or token inception.
Top250 daily index lists two IDs absent from current minute Top250; they are not silently added to its denominator.
Binance year-depth is an independent snapshot; do not merge its monthly counts into the federated 1m series.
The previous 2026-10-12 reconciliation is kept as a dated historical snapshot, not rewritten.
HYPE has four noncontiguous verified Bitget Spot months in current federation; no twelve-month continuity is implied.
Original exchange quote (USDT vs USDC) and venue are retained. No USD/EUR conversion, no interpolation, no reconstructed OHLCV.
